title: The battlefield changes when the Guru is with you
summary: Praise cools the mind, and the Perfect Guru turns the arduous field into a place of victory. Fear changes when the battle is no longer fought alone.
takeaway: Let praise cool the battlefield before you decide you are losing.
lifeApplication: When the day feels combative, sing one line before answering back. Let the Guru cool the field before you name the outcome.

source.shortMeaning: Praise cools the mind as the Guru turns life's hard field toward victory.
source.lifeApplication: When fear makes life feel combative, ask for the Guru's nearness before reacting.
